retrieval_rule: Re-check current terms and rights at each run.

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.rights: Metadata and snapshot terms must be checked at retrieval time.
sources.role: broad works, authors, institutions, topics, citations

sources.name: Crossref
sources.rights: Most metadata is openly reusable; abstracts can carry separate copyright.

sources.name: arXiv
sources.rights: Article files retain submission-specific licenses; metadata and content rights are tracked separately.
sources.role: modern research metadata and permitted source/full text

sources.name: Common Crawl
sources.rights: Presence in a crawl does not grant redistribution rights.
sources.role: discovery layer for the broader public web

sources.name: zbMATH Open
sources.rights: Use only after accepting and recording current API terms.

sources.name: OEIS
sources.rights: CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution and share-alike must remain attached.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.rights: Structured data is CC0; linked media and sources may differ.
sources.role: identity, dates, works, people, historical reconciliation

sources.name: Internet Archive
sources.rights: Rights vary by item and file; public access is not proof of public-domain status.
sources.role: historical books, scans, manuscripts, preserved pages

sources.name: Mathlib
sources.rights: Preserve repository license, commit, imports, and declaration names.

sources.name: MacTutor History of Mathematics Archive
sources.rights: Index and cite; do not mirror prose without permission.

sources.name: Clay Mathematics Institute
sources.rights: Reference and quote only within applicable rights.
sources.role: official Millennium Problem status and descriptions
